gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.body: Create an account, then log in with your username and password. You can complete or update your personal information at any time from the Profile page. Once signed in, use the main navigation - Home, Passenger, Driver, Add Post and Profile - to move around the app.

browsing.title: Browsing Publications
browsing.intro: The Home page lists every publication, newest first. Each card shows its status, departure and arrival points, available seats and the publisher's gender - tap a card to see full details, including the departure date and time, remarks and contact information.
browsing.statusNote: Passenger and Driver are publication statuses, not separate account types - every user can publish as either one.
browsing.passengerBody: Need a ride? Publish a Passenger post. The Passenger page shows only Passenger publications, so it's easy to browse them on their own.
browsing.driverBody: Have a seat to offer? Publish a Driver post with your departure, arrival, available seats, date, time, phone number and any remarks. The Driver page shows only Driver publications.

creating.title: Creating a Publication
creating.body: Tap the + button, choose Passenger or Driver, then fill in the departure point, arrival point, available seats, remarks, departure date, departure time and a contact phone number. Confirm with OK to publish, or Cancel to discard.

reservation.title: Driver Reservation Availability
reservation.default: When you publish a Driver post, its Reservation availability starts OFF, meaning the post is available.
steps: Someone interested contacts you using the phone number (or social links) on your post.
You agree on the trip together, outside the app.
Once your seats are taken, open History, find your post, and switch Reservation to ON.
Other users then see the post grayed out as Reserved.
reservation.clarificationBody: Reservation is only an availability indicator, not a booking system. CovoiturageTN does not process payments, booking requests or automatic confirmations - the trip itself is always arranged between users through their own contact information.

history.title: Your History
history.body: Open History from the menu to see every publication you've created, filterable by All, Driver or Passenger. Each of your Driver posts shows a Reservation switch you can turn ON or OFF at any time - only you can change it.
history.grayBody: When a Driver marks Reservation as ON, other users see that post in gray. The post isn't deleted or hidden - the gray appearance simply shows the trip is no longer available.

profile.title: Profile & Language
profile.body: Your Profile page holds your personal information, password settings with a strength indicator, and the Language selector. Switch between English, French and Arabic at any time from Profile → Language.

support.title: Help, Support & Logout
support.body: Use Help and Support from the menu whenever you need assistance. When you're done for the day, Logout securely ends your session.
